title: poa nemoralis subsp. feratiana
intro: Poa nemoralis subsp. feratiana, commonly known as alpine meadow grass or mountain meadow grass, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the grass family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Poa nemoralis subsp. feratiana include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
